'''Mark Lumbert''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[September 2000 Parker tournament]] on 30 September 2000 with [[Set Your Course For Alderaan / The Ultimate Power In The Universe|SYCFA/SFS Tie swarm]], according to Brian Hunter's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1285">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-01-parker-co-9-30-00-jesus-goes-to-parkerd1285/ parker-co-9-30-00-jesus-goes-to-parker], DeckTech (Brian "HuntaWarya" Hunter, 1 October 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-01-parker-co-9-30-00-jesus-goes-to-parkerd1285/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
